title: Condition-dependent regioselectivity in the Heck reaction
difficulty_reasons: Requires investigator-chosen catalyst models and computed competing α/β bond-forming pathways for two sets of conditions.
Connects coordination-state changes and productive-state access costs with competition within each state.
Requires matched styrene comparisons and physically consistent references without inferring complete catalyst speciation.
